brief:
Israeli occupation forces disrupted the olive harvest in Silwan village south of Al-Aqsa Mosque on Friday, Shehab Wire reported. Local sources said the troops prevented residents from entering their land in the Wadi al-Rababa neighborhood and obstructed the picking operation.

The disruption affected Palestinians attempting to gather olives from their properties during the annual harvest season in the occupied East Jerusalem community.

title: Israeli forces block olive harvest in Silwan
